historical_forecast_error.eligibility_note: Each observation is the consensus on the eve of the result — lead time ~0 — so it measures last-mile surprise: a cross-check on scenario severity and on how wrong late consensus has been. It is NOT a distribution of how far consensus moves over a holding period; that needs point-in-time consensus snapshots, which no Estimates Report carries. Each 'actual' is the figure CIQ's Estimates set against its own consensus, which is often NOT the line the financial statements report; `accounting_basis` names the filer's accounting STANDARD (US GAAP, IFRS), never the basis of that actual.
historical_forecast_error.usage_note: EBIT- or EBITDA-level shock today: error_per_forecast_revenue × today's revenue consensus. Revenue × margin scenario: the SAME year's Revenue pct_error and ratio_error, kept together. ratio_error alone answers how wrong the margin (or capex-intensity) forecast was, and multiplied by revenue it drops the revenue miss's effect.
